notes.title: Added Encounter Mode
notes.content: In the encounter mode, the tank strength of both sides will be adjusted based on the player's performance.

notes.title: Performance optimization.
notes.content:
1. Performance optimization.
2. Replace the camera with a top-down view.
Additional: The original intention is to do large-scale battles, but the current performance situation can only support up to 200 tanks, that is, the battle in the demo is the largest scale, and the top-down view will greatly improve the performance, but there will be some insufficient information because the view is not as far as before,

notes.title: All objectives for the official release have been met
notes.content:
1. All open world Soviet maps have been opened; the campaign starts with Minsk for the Barbarossa Project and ends in Berlin for the Battle of Berlin
2. Armor piercing system adjusted to real physics
3. Huge railway system established, camp system fielding opened
4. Additional tank system opened
5. Personnel system opened

notes.title: The open map rpg mode has been opened
notes.content:
There are three battles in Moscow. After the victory of the battle, the response score will be increased and the response equipment will be unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42510078/d7f993aa333ba58f8d469377c5d207bcc6d8c3ee.png[/img]
The train system was added due to the large map. Press the space to get on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42510078/2d6e1610f92449b66a3cd7f05b112a9f2ad28e8f.png[/img]
The first version of the world map has been added, which is rough. It will be beautified later.

notes.title: Open maps are being developed
notes.content:
Open maps are being developed, research has been conducted to find that technology can be achieved, and intensive development is underway.
1, in the open map, due to the map too large long distance march will become very boring, the new added train system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42510078/2d6e1610f92449b66a3cd7f05b112a9f2ad28e8f.png[/img]
2. Historical battles will take place in historical locations.
3. There will be more diversified gameplay, such as unlocking weapons through battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42510078/f56f30f5a907609e855c3c3ceff06b5c3237e892.png[/img]

notes.title: German campaign is fully developed
notes.content: This update has completed the development of the German line, and enemies such as anti-tank fortresses and Gorky fortresses have also been added to the map.

notes.title: The German line was added
notes.content: The German line was added, and although Germany only added one campaign, the tanks were all in one.

notes.content: Students, the defense of Moscow began with the parade

notes.title: Added spectator mode
notes.content: You can check the spectator mode in the settings, and each campaign will become a free camera to watch. You can see the battlefield situation, and you can choose the right tank for the subsequent gameplay.
